newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold trims early gains, silver ends steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold trims early gains, silver ends steady.

text.p: Gold prices opened higher on the back of modest recovery in the world market on Monday but demand resistance and light profit-taking trimmed early gains towards the close, dealer said.
Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 100 rupees lower at 59,600 rupees per piece. They were down by 50 rupees on Saturday.
Silver opened higher but improved arrivals of the imported metal dragged prices downward later in the day, dealers said.
"Industrial buying was scattered and volume was poor," a dealer said. Silver was up by 10 rupees per kg on Saturday.
